subject: Arte
description_pt: Explorar e analisar elementos constitutivos da música (altura, intensidade, timbre, melodia, ritmo etc.), por meio de recursos tecnológicos (games e plataformas digitais), jogos, canções e práticas diversas de composição/criação, execução e apreciação musicais.

components.description_pt: Identificar elementos constitutivos da música por meio de práticas musicais variadas
components.description_en: Identify constituent elements of music (pitch, dynamics, timbre, melody, rhythm) through varied musical practices
components.cc_component_description: Identify structural elements of poems such as verse, rhythm, and meter

components.description_pt: Analisar o funcionamento de elementos musicais em composições usando plataformas digitais ou jogos
components.description_en: Analyze how musical elements function within compositions using digital platforms or games
components.cc_component_description: Analyze how structural units within a text develop plot, theme, or meaning

components.description_pt: Explorar criação e performance musical manipulando elementos musicais fundamentais
components.description_en: Explore musical creation and performance by manipulating core musical elements
components.cc_component_description: Analyze how a live or recorded performance interprets and alters elements of a written text

components.description_pt: Apreciar obras musicais reconhecendo e descrevendo seus elementos constitutivos
components.description_en: Appreciate musical works by recognizing and describing their constituent elements

cc_matches.description: Explain major differences between poems, drama, and prose, and refer to the structural elements of poems (e.g., verse, rhythm, meter) and drama (e.g., casts of characters, settings, descriptions, dialogue, stage directions) when writing or speaking about a text.
Explain how a series of chapters, scenes, or stanzas fits together to provide the overall structure of a particular story, drama, or poem.

Compare and contrast the experience of reading a story, drama, or poem to listening to or viewing an audio, video, or live version of the text, including contrasting what they "see" and "hear" when reading the text to what they perceive when they listen or watch.
